action_type.description: The action to perform: reset, reg, end, or clear.

lockspace_name.description: The name of the sanlock lockspace to target.

target_host_id.description: The host ID of the target host in the lockspace.

generation.description: The generation number of the host. Use 0 to disable generation checking.

sysrq_reboot.description: Enable use of /proc/sysrq-trigger to reboot the target host.

resource_mode.description: Use resource leases to protect storage during the reset process.

native_timeout.description: Native timeout value. 0 disables the native timeout.
